markdown:
The committee will meet again on Tuesday evening at seven. Enclosed please find the receipt for the amount paid in ful Please forward to the county clerk before Friday. We received forty-two crates of apples on the ninth of March, 1914. Kindly let me know whether the shipment arrived in good order. I remain, with great respect, your obedient servant. The committee will meet again on Tuesday evening.

Escaneado con CamScanne
